posts.title: Servers, skins and waypoints
items: Servers tab: save favorite servers, see who's online, and join in one click.
Skins tab: a 3D preview, a skin library, and one-click skin changes.
Waypoints in game: save places, see them in the world and on the compass.
Server profiles: FlintFix switches to your chosen module profile when you join a server.
Performance mode installs Sodium, Lithium and other speed-up mods in one click.
The launcher now tells you when a new FlintFix version is out.

posts.title: Ten new modules
items: Potion effects, speed meter and compass bar HUD widgets.
Low fire, shield and totem, damage numbers, no weather, motion blur and team glow.

posts.title: Resource packs and a cinematic sky
items: Browse and preview resource packs in the new Packs tab.
Show Hand holds your item, with a new Inspect animation.
A more cinematic Custom Sky and a redesigned HUD.
